A Birthday Message 💌

From Biruk, with love and almost three years of memories.

Betelhem, Happy Birthday ❤️ Today is about celebrating you — the beautiful person who has been part of so many of my favorite memories. Almost three years ago, we began a journey together. We studied together, faced the pressure and challenges of student life together, supported each other through difficult days, and eventually had the joy of graduating together. When I look back, I don't only remember the classes or the graduation. I remember the little moments in between — the laughs, the conversations, the support, and simply having you beside me. Happy Birthday, my special person. May this new year of your life bring you happiness, peace, success, and many reasons to smile. With love, Biruk Dessalegn Berhe ❤️
